text:
maria: quick q about /v1/generate and the semantics of `model_hint` when a model is marked deprecated in the catalog. do we 1) still accept and try to route, 2) return a warning header, or 3) return an error? integrating with region/tier routing and need consistent contract.

alex: we treat `model_hint` as advisory. deprecated models remain routable for a grace period (30d) with a warning header. we only 400/409 if the model is incompatible or disallowed by policy.

jonathan: to add: the API contract guarantees response schema stability (status codes + JSON shape). it does NOT guarantee the exact model outputs. so clients should not rely on identical logits.

maria: ok so clients will get 200 + warning header rather than an error for deprecation? that solves the rollout issue. is the header `X-Redwood-Warning` or something more specific?

alex: yep — header is `X-Redwood-Warning: model deprecation: redwood-13b-v1 (deprecated)`. also add `X-Redwood-Routed-Model` with the final model id used. example:

```
X-Redwood-Warning: model deprecation: redwood-13b-v1 (deprecated)
X-Redwood-Routed-Model: redwood-13b-quant-v2
```

sam: one nuance: region/tier routing. if a hint points to an EU-only model but request originates us-east and customer has `require_region_match:true`, we must not route across regions. behavior in that case? fail fast?

jonathan: for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments we respect `require_region_match:true` and return 409 with a small error body explaining region mismatch. Hosted default is `region-first` fallback — we try nearest compatible variant in the same data residency; only if none exist we use cross-region fallback (with audit header).

maria: so to summarize: `model_hint` = advisory, deprecated hints => 200 + `X-Redwood-Warning`, region mismatch => 409 only when tenant policy forbids cross-region routing. otherwise fallback to nearest compatible. sounds good.

dawn: i'll add e2e coverage: checks for presence of headers, and a test that asserts 409 when `require_region_match` is true and no local variant. ping me when the routing PR is up.

alex: one technical check for eng-ml/runtime: ensure `fallback_policy` options are documented in API spec. propose adding `fallback_policy: ["model-first","region-first","strict"]` to /v1/generate params and default to `region-first`. sample request snippet:

```json
{
  "prompt": "...",
  "model_hint": "redwood-13b-v1",
  "fallback_policy": "region-first"
}
```

sam: thanks — will this be breaking? please confirm default stays same so existing clients unaffected.

alex: default = `region-first` (no break). we will add deprecation header and a small changelog entry. also adding a runtime metric `routed_model_differs` so product can monitor.

maria: awesome. i'll update product docs and add a snippet showing header handling. Dawn — i'll assign the QA ticket to you.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: routing-service v2.3 -> staging at 2026-03-19T14:00Z :rocket:.

jonathan: thanks all. i'll put a short blurb in the API contract section and link the new tests. :thumbsup:
